The '''Cularin Militia''' was a military force with loyalty to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. It resisted incursions of the [[Thaereian military]] into the system, which earned them the [[Gold Order of Cularin]]. [[Osten Dal'Nay]] and [[Broof Yurdel]] were both leaders of it.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was renamed the '''Cularin Armed Forces''' and became part of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="Destruction">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: Destruction}}</ref> After the conflict ended, it became independent again.<ref name="EOTJ">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref>
